For an id above 0xffff 0x5b79d0 does 'mov ecx,[eax*4+0xb3d52c]; call 0x5bfbf0' and 'mov ecx,[edi]; call 0x5c0160' without a null test: 0x5bfbf0 reads +0x14c (null -> return 0, so 0x5bf820 is skipped) and 0x5c0160 reads +0x174 and +0x170 (null child lists -> return without writing). For an id up to 0xffff it does 'test eax,eax; je' then 'cmp dword [eax+0x30],0xb; je' (skip) before a virtual call [vtbl+0x60]; +0x30 = 0xb keeps an object that a low id would also select on that skip path, since a generated object has no vtable. Everything else zero: an object with no child lists.
